scope: Read-only scientific review of four reactions, 19 members, family-selector limitations and endpoint evaluator; no independent checker execution by reviewer.

findings.issue: Family membership cannot certify exact substrate/pathway implementation or compatible partners.
findings.resolution: Exact reviewed accessions and matched partner sets are required by the source-scoped evaluator; family-only and cross-species substitutes return NOT_ESTABLISHED.

findings.issue: Exact GO matching falsely rejects specific GO0016509 supporting ancestor GO0003857.
findings.resolution: Persisted official QuickGO response and apply its ancestor entailment. Structural-pair positive cases pass without changing gene annotations.

findings.issue: Native LT2 observations and E. coli gene exchanges must remain distinct.
findings.resolution: Comparative participation profile explicitly names both separate evidence contexts and does not conflate assay conditions.

limits: Cases requesting unsupported C16-FadE2 or C4-Mtb contexts are absence of established support, not independent proofs of absent activity.
Claim whitelists and mutation tests enforce curated boundaries; they do not independently establish literature truth.
Official family identity and member placement are validated separately from the executable capacity evaluator.
root_verification: Final module/endpoint runner passes54cases and12mutations; no biochemical blocker reported by reviewer. Full-corpus validation and external PR review remain required.
